Subject: Intro demo & quick agenda (30m) — Redwood Inference + Ember Park

Hi Ethan / Sasha,

Thanks again for the chat yesterday — really appreciate the context around Ember Park's platform migration. As discussed, I wanted to lock in a short technical demo to show how Redwood can reduce per-token cost during peak ingestion and how our dedicated routing can keep latency predictable for your real-time search use case.

Proposed agenda (30m):
- 5m: quick intros and success criteria
- 15m: live demo (ingestion -> search latency demo)
- 5m: deployment options & security controls
- 5m: next steps / MAP

Attachments: redwood-inference-demo-deck.pdf, mutual-action-plan.xlsx (high-level).

Are you available next Tue/Wed afternoon (PST)? If those don't work, share a couple windows and we'll accommodate. If now's not the right time because of your sprint, totally fine — tell me and we can pause and revisit later.

Cheers,

Chloe Martin
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
chloe.martin@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0123

Subject: Re: Intro demo & quick agenda (30m) — Redwood Inference + Ember Park

Hi Chloe,

Appreciate you reaching out and for the clear agenda. Quick update from our side — we had an emergency reprioritization in product last night. The core infra team that would lead any pilot has been pulled into a platform stability sprint (migration to the new event pipeline) that will run through mid-March. Given that, we need to deprioritize the LLM/inference pilot for now.

Can we put the demo on hold and revisit in ~6–8 weeks? If you want, feel free to send the short deck and any one-pager technical notes so our engineering lead can skim them asynchronously. We’ll reach back out when capacity frees up.

Sorry for the pivot — we were excited to see Redwood’s latency numbers but right now headcount is locked to the migration.

Thanks,
Ethan
Ethan Lowe
Director of Platform Engineering | Ember Park
ethan.lowe@emberpark.com | (617) 555-0199
